description: spell-epic's hooks for Codex (epic epic-friend P11):  each turn's end commits and syncs the shared plans (epic turn end), and a new session hears when its worktree is behind main or the last sync stopped on a conflict.  Codex's own file:  Claude Code's hooks.json names events Codex hasn't got.  epic plugin install --codex copies it into ~/.codex/hooks.json, ${PLUGIN_ROOT} made the kit's epic/ folder and --codex-plugin dropped:  with that flag (this file, run by the plugin) a script does nothing while the user file runs it, so the hooks never run twice

hooks.statusMessage: epic turn end:  committing the shared plans
